verdicts.typography: Flawless typographic hierarchy and Swiss-style discipline. Mono uppercase micro-labels, generous line-height, and precise weight contrast are perfectly executed across all sections.
verdicts.color: Excellent minimalist palette with a single restrained red accent. One minor nitpick: the red left rule on the final 'THIS SYSTEM' matrix column (d3-matrix) appears to extend 1-2px below the table's bottom border, creating a tiny visual overshoot at the corner.
verdicts.layout: Publication-grade grid alignment. Consistent max-w container usage, pristine hairline borders with no double-lines or misalignments, and correct footer pinning at the document bottom (d8-footer).
verdicts.components: High-quality component architecture. The sticky first column functions correctly with the intended shadow (d9-matrix-scrolled). Minor deduction: in d3-matrix, the red vertical rule on the 'THIS SYSTEM' header/column slightly overhangs the table container's bottom edge by a pixel or two.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless execution across mobile (390px) and dark-mode viewports. Mobile layout maintains integrity with no overflow or clipped text; the wide Matrix table handles horizontal scrolling correctly, including the sticky first-column shadow interaction. Dark mode demonstrates consistent palette usage and high contrast throughout.

color: In d3-matrix, adjust the red left-border (border-left or pseudo-element) on the final 'THIS SYSTEM' column so its height exactly matches the table row height or container height, eliminating the 1-2px bottom overshoot.
components: In d3-matrix, constrain the red vertical rule on the 'THIS SYSTEM' column to precisely align with the bottom border of the table container, removing the slight extension below the grid line.
